result.question: Why was there no one to rescue the people of Laish?

readings.answer: Because it was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone.
readings.support: because the city was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone

assessments.reason: It directly quotes the verse’s explanation that there was no one to deliver them because the city was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone.

result.reason: Verse 18:28 explicitly gives the reason: far from Sidon and no alliance with anyone.
